lifecycle_future_information_matrix.lifecycle_first_rule: Future completion/termination cannot define an earlier-state cohort; completed may be a later outcome or later anchor (protocol rule 4; claim AP001-A01-C016).
lifecycle_future_information_matrix.classification_rule: FUTURE_RELATIVE_TO_STATE requires direct evidence that a field's value is computed from information not available at the state's anchor time; name-based classification is prohibited (claim AP001-A01-C023).
lifecycle_future_information_matrix.cell_population_policy: Cells are populated only from direct payload-internal evidence. With zero exposed detector fields, every safe_at_state and future_relative_to_state cell is empty because nothing is classifiable — not because fields were judged future.
